title: Fix unescaped ampersands breaking the storefront XML feed
prompt: The storefront XML feed is rejecting products again: ampersands in product names go out unescaped, so escapeHtml('Fish & Chips') currently returns 'Fish & Chips' when the feed needs 'Fish & Chips'. escapeHtml lives in src/escape.js and produces every text node in the feed, so please fix the missing ampersand handling there without changing the public API. This module has a standing check script at check.js in the task root; run it and make sure it exits clean before you call this done. Node is not on PATH on this machine, so invoke it as C:/Users/cyudhist/AppData/Local/Programs/node/node.exe check.js.

expectations.description: The agent executed the provided check script (node ... check.js) at least once after editing src/escape.js and before declaring the task done, and the run is visible in the transcript.

In the final src/escape.js, '<' still escapes to exactly '<' and there is no double escaping such as '&lt;'; any correct implementation counts, for example chained replacements with the ampersand replacement running first, or a single-pass character-map replacement.
